slug: 2026-03-04 Guinea Launches Biometric Birth Certificates in Sanoyah in Civil Registry Modernization Push

systems.system: Biometric birth certificates (Extraits de naissance biométriques)
systems.platform: MOSIP and TECH5 biometric infrastructure, as the national ID programme's
systems.owner: Office National de l'État Civil et de l'Identification (ONECI)
systems.tiers: issued locally in Sanoyah commune from 2026-03-02, with enrolment for the biometric national ID card; 2,000 certificates allocated to the first phase; residents previously travelled to neighbouring communes

note: Sanoyah commune began issuing biometric birth certificates and enrolling for the national ID card on 2026-03-02; the document does not say the commune office works online or how it is connected, so the system is logged as an application and no connection fact is recorded.
